root_cause: The production locale verifier polled location and document.documentElement.lang inside page.waitForFunction while a real navigation was replacing the document.
During the navigation lifecycle the evaluated document could transiently have no documentElement, causing a TypeError even though the route commit, production SHA and pricing content were correct.

evidence.production_source_snapshot_failure: page.waitForFunction TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'lang')

prevention: Start the navigation wait before clicking or selecting the real language control.
Use page.waitForURL with waitUntil=commit for exact-path route proof instead of polling the old/new document during replacement.
After commit, require a visible body, exact html[lang], localized visible content and absence of runtime translation failure.
Keep NL routes canonical without /nl/* leakage.
